definition: the collapse of an order or routine
description: On a lit-up disco floor of bright pink, orange and blue squares, a young woman in a gold sequin crop top and white flared trousers dances close up with her arms raised. As the view moves back, four young women in the same gold tops, white trousers and gold heels appear, but their routine has fallen apart: each one moves in a different direction and at a different moment, one throws her arms up, one reaches sideways and one stands still. A mirror ball and a ring of silver spotlights hang above.
